definition_en: to surrender, especially on agreed terms; to stop resisting and give in to demands
core_image: 守城者把钥匙从城门上递下来：不是溃败，而是按条款交出
scene: 谈判僵持到深夜，最后总裁在合作协议上签了字。The union refused to capitulate on the pension clause.
sceneCN: 这里 capitulate 是「让步」（第 2 个义项：停止抵抗、答应对方要求）；句意是工会拒绝在养老金条款上让步。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「投降；（按条款的）让步」
动词加施动后缀，义为「投降者；让步者」（罕用）
同根拉丁借词，义为「头状花序；小头；（植物学）」

senses.title: Surrender on agreed terms
senses.definition: to surrender a fortified place or an army under negotiated conditions rather than by force
senses.definitionCN: 在协商好的条件下交出要塞或军队，而非被武力击溃
senses.example: The garrison capitulated after the water ran out.
senses.exampleCN: 水源断绝后，守军投降了。
senses.why: The Roman practice was to settle surrender chapter by chapter, under headings.
senses.whyCN: 罗马人的做法是把投降条件一条条写下来，分章议定。

senses.title: Give in to pressure or demands
senses.definition: to stop resisting and accept what an opponent or circumstance demands
senses.definitionCN: 停止抵抗，接受对手或形势所提出的要求
senses.example: He capitulated and agreed to the pay cut.
senses.exampleCN: 他让步了，同意了减薪方案。
senses.why: Everyday defeat is likewise settled clause by clause, one concession after another.
senses.whyCN: 日常的「败退」同样是一条款一款款谈出来的，让步逐条发生。

senses.title: Yield to temptation or inclination
senses.definition: to abandon resistance to a strong desire or temptation
senses.definitionCN: 放弃对强烈欲望或诱惑的抵抗
senses.example: After a week of dieting she capitulated to the dessert cart.
senses.exampleCN: 节食一周后，她向甜品车缴了械。
senses.why: The inner enemy is treated like a besieging force with its own terms.
senses.whyCN: 内心的敌手被当作一支前来劝降的围城之师。

intro.en: Capitulate comes from Medieval Latin capitulare, to draw up under headings, from capitulum, little head or chapter; surrender was negotiated article by article.
intro.cn: capitulate 来自中世纪拉丁语 capitulare（按标题拟定），词根 capitulum（小头、章节）；投降正是按条款逐条谈成的。

items.en: The root *kaput- means head, ancestor of capital and captain.
items.cn: 词根 *kaput- 意为「头」，是 capital、captain 的祖先。

items.en: Latin caput meant head; the diminutive capitulum meant a little head, then a chapter heading.
items.cn: 拉丁语 caput 意为头；指小词 capitulum 意为小头，进而指章节标题。

items.en: Medieval Latin capitulare meant to arrange under chapters, as treaties and church rules were written.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 capitulare 意为按章节编排，条约与教会法规皆如此书写。

items.en: English first used capitulate for drawing up articles, then narrowed to surrender terms.
items.cn: 英语最初用 capitulate 表示「拟定条款」，随后收窄为「按条款投降」。

items.en: Modern use extends from armies to negotiations and private temptation.
items.cn: 现代用法从军队扩展到谈判乃至私人欲望。

note.en: Capitulate belongs to the head-word family and stands beside a row of surrender synonyms with different shades.
note.cn: capitulate 属「头」词族，并与一排各有细微差别的「投降」近义词相邻。

entries.definition: The act or terms of surrendering.
The Latin diminutive for a small head, a chapter, or a flower head.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语指小词，指小头、章节或头状花序。

entries.definition: Relating to a chapter of a book or an ecclesiastical chapter.
entries.definitionCN: 与章节或教士会议有关的形容词，同根。

entries.definition: To summarize by headings, the same chapter root with re-.
entries.definitionCN: 按要点概括、复述，同一章节词根加 re- 前缀。

entries.definition: To give up resistance, the plain general word.
To give way under pressure, often gradually.
entries.definitionCN: 在压力下让步，常为渐进过程。

entries.definition: To admit or grant a point, often in argument.
entries.definitionCN: 承认或让予某一点，多用于争论。
顶住压力继续抵抗，是 capitulate 的反义对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the chapter-by-chapter surrender story.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「逐章议降」典故的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root story: capitulum, little head, became a chapter heading; capitulate is to settle under headings.
normal.cn: 词根典故：capitulum（小头）变成章节标题；capitulate 即按标题逐条议定。

normal.en: Twin word: recapitulate sums a text by chapters; capitulate sums a defeat by articles.
normal.cn: 孪生词：recapitulate 按章概括文本，capitulate 按条款总结败局。

normal.en: Family row: capital, captain, chapter, and capitulate all wear the same head.
normal.cn: 家族队列：capital、captain、chapter、capitulate 都戴着同一颗「头」。

normal.en: Grammar frame: capitulate almost always takes to, as in capitulate to pressure.
normal.cn: 语法框架：capitulate 几乎总与 to 搭配，如 capitulate to pressure。

normal.en: Negotiation shade: it implies terms were agreed, a negotiated collapse rather than a rout.
normal.cn: 语义色彩：它暗含条件谈妥，是协商出的溃退而非溃散。

abstract.en: A parchment of numbered clauses pushed across the parapet, each one a small defeat.
abstract.cn: 一纸编号条款从城垛上递过来，每一条都是一次小小的败北。

abstract.en: Fists slowly unclenching over a bargaining table at midnight.
abstract.cn: 午夜谈判桌上缓缓松开的拳头。

abstract.en: A walled garden whose gate opens only when the besieger promises to prune gently.
abstract.cn: 一座围起来的花园，直到围攻者许诺轻柔修剪，园门才肯打开。

examples.en: The fortress capitulated after a siege of forty days.
examples.cn: 围困四十天后，要塞守军投降了。

examples.en: Editors rarely capitulate to threats from advertisers.
examples.cn: 编辑们很少向广告商的威胁低头。

examples.en: He swore he would never capitulate, then capitulated within the hour.
examples.cn: 他发誓绝不屈服，结果一小时内就缴械了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克批六雷特」——谈判桌上被批得六亲不认、雷声轰顶，终于点头让步，正是投降；联想投降书一条条分章拟就，章章是小头（capitulum）。

root: 源自中世纪拉丁语 capitulare（按章节拟定），词基 capitulum（小头；章节），为 caput（头）的指小词，可上溯至印欧词根 *kaput-（头）。古罗马以「分章拟条」的方式议定投降，故 capitulate 演变为「按条款投降」，再泛化为「让步、屈服」。同根词有 chapter、capital、captain、recapitulate。

sensesIntro.en: From armies signing articles of surrender the word spreads to negotiations and private temptation.
sensesIntro.cn: 从签署投降条款的军队出发，词义扩展到谈判与私人的诱惑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: surrender written up under little heads, article by article.
core.cn: 核心意象：投降被写成分条列款的小标题，一条一条谈成。

branches.en: THE GATE: armies and garrisons handing over under terms.
branches.cn: 城门：军队与守军按条款交出防务。

branches.en: THE TABLE: negotiators conceding clause after clause.
branches.cn: 谈判桌：逐条让步的谈判者。

branches.en: THE DESSERT CART: private appetites treated as besiegers.
branches.cn: 甜品车：把私人欲望当作围城之师。

branches.en: THE DOCUMENT: capitulation as a signed text, not a scattered rout.
branches.cn: 文书：capitulation 是签了字的文本，不是四散的溃逃。

branches.en: THE MORAL: surrender as a choice one can refuse.
branches.cn: 道德维度：投降是一种可以拒绝的选择。

intro.en: Capitulate is capitul- plus the verb ending -ate, to arrange under little heads.
intro.cn: capitulate 由词干 capitul- 加动词词尾 -ate 构成，即「按小标题编排」。

latinIntro.en: The kaput- head root is one of Latin's most fruitful, seeding law, army, and book vocabulary alike.
latinIntro.cn: kaput-「头」词根是拉丁语最多产的词根之一，同时滋养法律、军队与书籍词汇。

第一章（拉丁语用例示意）。

a division of a book; an assembly
chief city; wealth; punishable by death

latinEntries.exampleCN: 拟定条款（中世纪拉丁语用例示意）。
